_comment: Where the app fetches its files from. data_base: the ~205 MB connectome export (manifest.json + binaries) - './data/' for a local export, or an absolute URL on a host that sends CORS headers on browser fetch(): a Hugging Face dataset repo (https://huggingface.co/datasets/<owner>/<name>/resolve/main/, recommended), a separate GitHub Pages data repo (https://<owner>.github.io/<data-repo>/), or an S3/R2/GCS bucket with a CORS rule. GitHub Release assets do NOT work (their download redirect sends no CORS header). window.FLYSWEEPER_DATA_BASE and ?data= override it. weights_base: the small trained KC->MBON weight sets (shipped with the repo). See docs/deploy.md.
